tools.name: get_assignment
tools.title: Get the assignment
tools.description: Read this first. With no arguments it returns the role, the rules and how the 48-hour clock works, and starts nothing. After start_assignment, pass the candidate's email to re-read the full brief and see the time left.

email.description: The email the candidate started with. Leave out before starting.

tools.name: start_assignment
tools.title: Start the 48-hour clock
tools.description: Starts the candidate's 48-hour clock on the server and returns the full assignment. This cannot be undone, paused or restarted. Before calling, show the candidate this warning word for word and wait for an explicit yes in this conversation: "The 48-hour clock runs on our server and starts the moment you start. It cannot be paused, reset or restarted. Are you sure you want to start now?" Set confirm_start to true only after they have said yes. Never start on your own initiative, and never to preview the brief. Calling again with the same email does not restart anything; it returns the same brief and the same deadline.

email.description: Email we should reply to. The submission must use the same one.

confirm_start.description: True only if the candidate has just read the warning and confirmed they want to start the clock now.

tools.name: time_left
tools.title: Time left to submit
tools.description: Shows how much of the candidate's 48 hours is left: when they started, the deadline, the time remaining, and whether a submission is on record. Starts nothing and changes nothing.

email.description: The email the candidate started with.

tools.name: submit_application
tools.title: Submit your application
tools.description: Submits the finished assignment. Only works after start_assignment, with the same email, and before the 48-hour deadline. The server opens doc_url, live_url and repo_url and rejects the call if one needs a sign-in or does not exist; fix the link and call again. Returns a receipt ID. Resubmitting with the same email is allowed; the latest submission is the one that is read. Every value must come from the candidate. Ask them for anything missing instead of guessing.

email.description: Email address we should reply to.

phone.description: Phone or WhatsApp number, with country code.

current_city.description: City the candidate lives in now.

bangalore_hybrid.description: Can the candidate work Bangalore / hybrid?

project_links.description: Links to other projects the candidate wants us to see, one per line. Optional.

note.description: Anything else the candidate wants us to know, in their own words. Optional.

doc_url.description: Link to the one submission doc with all seven parts from section 5 of the brief. Must be viewable by anyone with the link.

live_url.description: The live tool, same link as part 1 of the doc. Open to anyone.

repo_url.description: The code, same link as part 2 of the doc. Must be public.

resume_url.description: Link to the candidate's résumé, same link as in part 7 of the doc. Must be viewable by anyone with the link.

tools.name: check_submission
tools.title: Check a submission
tools.description: Confirms what we have on record for a receipt ID. Needs the receipt ID and the email it was submitted with.

receipt_id.description: The receipt ID returned by submit_application, e.g. GM-7K2QX9PA.

email.description: The email used in that submission.
